video.acting_natural.evidence: [Riley·codex] 静音看，我在尝过食物后满意地举杯，转向观众、抬指示意，再喝酒并望向画右；能看懂“吃得满足”，看不出“接下来还得找床”。只看 Riley：图1中0–1.25秒舔手指，1.5–3秒取杯举起，4–4.75秒转向镜头，6–7.25秒抬左手示意，动作基本连贯。但图1第5行第7格（9.5秒）至第6行第6格（11.25秒），我已把杯口持续贴在嘴前饮酒；规格此时要求7.5–10.7秒仍对镜头说第二句，10.9秒才开始喝。这使规定的说话与饮酒动作发生冲突。仅凭拼图无法确认第二句是否提前、漏说或在饮酒时继续，无法确认这段表演自然衔接，判 fail。；[Asellina·claude] Judged from my own part (Asellina, frame left) on sheet 1. The spec has me raise my ladle in a toast during 3–4 s, stir the open pot while Riley speaks, then wipe the spill by the cup and look up to smile at her. Some of this works. From 0–2.75 s I hold the ladle and watch Riley with a smile. At about 3.0–3.75 s the ladle rises at an angle in answer to her toast. At about 8.5–9.0 s I lean in to stir. Three problems: (1) From about 4.0–8.25 s, which covers Riley's 'Okay, so garum — check', my pose stays nearly the same. I am smiling with the ladle angled into the pot, but I can't see a head shake or any real stirring, so I don't clearly react to her talking to the air. It reads like a prop pose. (2) From about 9.25–11.0 s I lean far forward with my arm stretched toward the middle and right of the counter, but no cloth is clearly in my hand. The cloth only shows up at 11.25–11.75 s, so the order 'pick up the cloth by the bowl, then wipe' is broken and the reach has no clear purpose. (3) From 12.0–13.75 s I am bent over the front-left corner of the counter, in front of me, head down and folding or wiping the cloth. That is not the spill beside the cup between us. The ending 'look up and smile at her' never clearly appears; at 13.25–13.75 s my face is at most half raised, and I can't confirm it is turned toward Riley. Points 1 and 3 are uncertain at this frame size, and per the rules I'm judging fail.

video.point_landed.evidence: [director·codex] 关声音看到的是：Riley舔手指、与老板娘举杯致意，转向镜头微笑并比划，随后饮酒、望向画右。满足感成立；但看不出“鱼露这一关过了”及“接下来还得找床”，只能辨认吃喝后的满足和对镜讲话。此外图1约9.25–10.75秒已举杯到嘴边饮用，侵入规格7.5–10.7秒的第二句对白拍；规格要求10.9秒后才喝酒。
